newsitem.title: LATVIA: Volume falls on Latvian bourse but stays high.
newsitem.headline: Volume falls on Latvian bourse but stays high.

text.p: Volume fell on Tuesday at Latvia's bourse but remained well above average, the Riga Stock Exchange said.
Overall market volume was just over 121,000 lats, down from 165,000 on Thursday but still a strong showing. Turnover is usually in the 20,000 -30,000 lat range.
Market leader Unibanka led the way with 87,500 lats worth of shares changing hands. Its price dipped from Thursday's high of 1.76 lats to 1.74 lats.
Unibanka seems to be thriving in Latvia's uncertain banking sector, which was plunged into crisis last year with the closure of the country's top bank Banka Baltiya.
The Riga Transportation Fleet's shares were also active, with almost 32,000 lats traded. Its price fell from 0.60 lats on Thursday to 0.57 lats.
